parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of rendering empty_form crashing when empty_permitted is passed to form_kwargs. However, it introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the get_form_kwargs method call.

issues.description: The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the get_form_kwargs method call, which may have unintended side effects.
